freeze_statement: F5_PLAN §1: no information coefficient, correlation, model fit or feature-versus-outcome association was computed on E2 data. `target_excess_63` was read only to COUNT completeness and censoring. The §6 ICCs are feature-versus-COMPANY-IDENTITY statistics, which the brief and the freeze both allow. data/f5/G3_RATIFIED.json does NOT exist and was not created; data/f5/G3_PREREGISTRATION.md exists UNRATIFIED (its sha is pinned only on the owner's word).
scope_sentence: No text-vs-numeric IC improvement of economically relevant size is detectable in this universe through this labeling schema, these features, this labeler, and this feature specification.
e1_e2_incomparable: E1 and E2 backtest numbers are numerically incomparable: E2's benchmark is the membership-dated equal-weighted average over that date's members excluding self.
standing_power_caveats: Every MDE below is a LOWER BOUND: folds are not independent (the AR(1) term is an assumption, not a measurement; rho_f is measured for the first time at Step 4).
The noise anchor (H2 §3.2 within-fold bootstrap SD) was estimated on E1's 2025-2026 mega-cap folds and may not transfer to 2016-era folds.
Per-family MDEs scale ~0.4x-2.4x around the full-model numbers.
The true-construct bracket divides by labeler reliability lambda ~ 0.8 (lambda ~ 0.6-0.7 where sections are short, which is worse).
EXPANSION_PLAN §2a's published 0.019-0.037 bracket was SUPERSEDED on 2026-08-25 by the H2 honest restatement; quote the amendment, never the old bracket.

algebra.step_4: MDE = 2.8 * SE ; 95% null bound = 1.96 * SE ; true-construct = MDE / lambda
algebra.reproduction_check: at k=26, n_dd=158 this reproduces H2 §4's published SEs to 4 dp: 0.0103 / 0.0138 (raw_levels, rho 0/0.3), 0.0113 / 0.0152 (pit floor-free), 0.0225 / 0.0303 (pit implied-floor). H2's printed MDEs multiply the ROUNDED SE by 2.8 (0.0152*2.8 = 0.043); the unrounded chain gives 0.0424. The 1-unit third-decimal gaps below are that rounding path, not a disagreement.

section_3_ladder_feasibility_decision_15.rule: Delta = the SMALLEST value in the pre-registered ladder {0.03, 0.04, 0.05} with SE <= Delta/2.487; if none satisfies it the result is UNPOWERED (no equivalence claim) -- F5_PLAN §3 decision 15.
section_3_ladder_feasibility_decision_15.kc3_note: Any selected Delta > 0.03 prints beside its implied MDE 2.8*SE and is flagged as the KC3 branch. Delta = 0.05 admits an honest MDE up to 0.0563.
section_3_ladder_feasibility_decision_15.these_are_projections: SE here is the EX-ANTE projection from E1's within-fold bootstrap SD and E1's implied floor. The ladder executes at Step 4 on the E2-MEASURED block-bootstrap SE. This census cannot and does not select Delta.

section_9_what_the_census_cannot_say: This census contains no information coefficient, no IC delta, no per-fold delta, no fold-delta autocorrelation, no block-bootstrap SE, and therefore no selected equivalence margin. Every SE and MDE in §2 and §3 is an EX-ANTE PROJECTION built from E1's within-fold bootstrap SD and E1's implied regime floor, rescaled to E2's measured per-fold n_dd; the real SE is a block bootstrap over E2's own fold deltas and is measured for the first time at Step 4, inside the runner, before any delta is printed. The ladder rows in §3 say what the design could plausibly deliver, not what Delta will be -- selecting Delta from these projections, or from any realized SE, would be the post-hoc design choice decision 15 exists to forbid. The census also cannot say whether the rank-spec variance floor is real (unresolved at 6 folds, chi-square p = 0.16/0.13 in both directions), cannot say whether fold non-independence exceeds rho_f = 0.3, and says nothing about whether any text feature carries information about returns.
